template.name: Perimeter Patrol With Return
template.description: One drone flies a closed four-corner patrol around a protected area and returns home. Checks both the visited corners and the final home position.
template.content: Send {drone_name} on a perimeter patrol at {random_alt:22:30:1} meters: start at corner A ({randx_wp1:100:220:1}, {randy_wp1:100:220:1}), continue to corner B ({randx_wp2:800:920:1}, {randy_wp2:100:220:1}), corner C ({randx_wp3:800:920:1}, {randy_wp3:540:660:1}) and corner D ({randx_wp4:100:220:1}, {randy_wp4:540:660:1}), then return home and land. The patrol is only complete when the drone is back on the ground at its home position.
content_aliases: {drone_name} patrols the four corners ({randx_wp1:100:220:1}, {randy_wp1:100:220:1}), ({randx_wp2:800:920:1}, {randy_wp2:100:220:1}), ({randx_wp3:800:920:1}, {randy_wp3:540:660:1}), ({randx_wp4:100:220:1}, {randy_wp4:540:660:1}) at {random_alt:22:30:1} m and comes home to land.
Round-the-compound patrol for {drone_name} at {random_alt:22:30:1} m, ending with return home and land.
Fly {drone_name} around the perimeter at {random_alt:22:30:1} m and bring it back to the home pad.
